message: The other night, I accidentally burned the bottom of my dinner while trying to multitask. Instead of panicking, I turned it into a cozy event by grabbing some blankets and pillows, setting up a little picnic in the living room, and we enjoyed our ‘charcoal special’ while watching a movie. It reminded me that even little mishaps can lead to unexpected family moments. So, while I remind myself to check the smoke alarms, I also appreciate the warmth of togetherness, even when things go a bit awry. 🏡
